title: Stepwise and lineage-specific divergence of a major immune co-chaperone complex in leptosporangiate ferns
authors: Jeong H; Sugihara Y; Webster MW; Carella P
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物免疫共伴侣蛋白RAR1-SGT1复合物的进化与结合特异性，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白互作界面，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

Protein-protein interactions are essential for proper cellular function and are often under strong evolutionary pressures to maintain their stability and specificity. In plants, a broadly distributed chaperone complex comprised of the RAR1 (REQUIRED FOR MLA12 RESISTANCE 1) and SGT1 (SUPRESSOR OF THE G2 ALLELE OF SKP1) co-chaperones alongside the HSP90 (HEAT SHOCK PROTEIN90) core chaperone are important for immunity. Despite its importance in flowering plants, a deeper understanding of how this complex evolved remains limited. Here, we examine the molecular evolutionary history of the RAR1-SGT1 interaction across land plants. We identified a lineage-specific divergence of the RAR1-SGT1 binding interface in vascular non-seed ferns, which renders orthologs unable to interact outside of their lineage. Further investigation of interface diversity uncovered a single amino acid residue in RAR1 and three corresponding residues in SGT1 that collectively dictate binding specificity. Ancestral state reconstruction supported stepwise evolution of specificity in SGT1 in leptopsporangiate ferns, which was initiated by a promiscuous intermediate state that widened its capacity to bind RAR1 before subsequent mutations locked in specificity. Our data highlight the broad conservation of the RAR1-SGT1 interface and the coevolutionary dynamics that shaped interface maintenance during lineage-specific diversification.
abstract_zh:
摘要

蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用对于细胞正常功能至关重要，并常受到强烈的进化压力以维持其稳定性和特异性。在植物中，由RAR1（REQUIRED FOR MLA12 RESISTANCE 1）和SGT1（SUPRESSOR OF THE G2 ALLELE OF SKP1）共伴侣蛋白与HSP90（HEAT SHOCK PROTEIN90）核心伴侣蛋白组成的广泛分布的伴侣复合体对免疫至关重要。尽管其在开花植物中具有重要意义，但对该复合体如何进化的深入理解仍然有限。在此，我们研究了陆生植物中RAR1-SGT1相互作用的分子进化历史。我们发现了维管无种子蕨类植物中RAR1-SGT1结合界面的谱系特异性分化，这导致直系同源物无法在其谱系之外相互作用。对界面多样性的进一步研究揭示，RAR1中的一个单一氨基酸残基和SGT1中的三个对应残基共同决定了结合特异性。祖先状态重建支持了薄囊蕨纲（leptosporangiate ferns）中SGT1特异性的逐步进化，该过程始于一个混杂的中间状态，该状态拓宽了其结合RAR1的能力，随后突变锁定了特异性。我们的数据强调了RAR1-SGT1界面的广泛保守性，以及塑造谱系特异性分化过程中界面维持的协同进化动态。
